predecessors.name: Lombards
predecessors.text: the Lombard conquests in Tuscany: 'Cleph completed its conquest after 572' (Kingdom of the Lombards page); the infobox lists the Byzantine Empire as the preceding entity

successors.name: Kingdom of the Lombards
successors.text: the restored Lombard kingdom, to which the dukes returned after the ten years of ducal rule

ledger.x: 576: the Lombard duchy of Tuscia arises at Lucca in the ducal anarchy.
586: the duchy's separate life ends as the Lombard kingdom is restored.

certainty.note: Ducal-anarchy borders are approximate; the border with the Byzantine Exarchate was fixed only by the 680 peace (Tuscia page), long after this duchy's separate life.
